Roofer / Roofing Specialist Job - Rotterdam, The Hague, NetherlandsAre you an experienced roofer who enjoys working outdoors? Do you have experience in pitched roof renovation, roof insulation or general construction? AMTwerkt is looking for motivated Roofers and Roofing Specialists for renovation and sustainable construction projects in the southwestern Netherlands. You will work on residential roofing projects in Rotterdam, Vlaardingen, The Hague and surrounding areas. Together with a professional team, you will renovate existing roofs, install insulation systems and ensure that homes are protected against the weather for years to come. This position offers a great opportunity for experienced roofers and construction workers who want to develop their skills in the Dutch roofing industry.  English- and/or German-speaking candidates are welcome to apply.  What will you do as a Roofer? As a Roofer / Roofing Specialist, you will work on the renovation and improvement of existing pitched roofs. Your main responsibilities include:  - Removing existing roof tiles and roofing materials.  - Preparing existing roof structures for renovation.  - Installing prefabricated roof insulation elements.  - Installing insulation boards and improving thermal performance.  - Fitting and securing new roof tiles and roofing components.  - Carrying out timber repairs and carpentry work on roof structures.  - Performing zinc roofing and gutter finishing work.  - Preparing roofs for solar panels and other sustainable solutions.  - Working with modern cranes, lifting equipment and professional tools.  - Checking measurements, workmanship and installation quality.  - Following safety procedures when working at height.  - Working together with colleagues to complete projects on schedule. Eenvoudig solliciteren Work Service and overhaul Cleanroom, from drawings 06:00-14:15 and 14:15-22:30 Language Dutch or English What you'll be doing This is cleanroom work with two sides to it. Some of the products come back in for service or overhaul: then it is your judgement that decides what is needed to bring them back to spec. Others are new, and you build them up for the first time. Both happen inside the cleanroom, in prescribed clothing and to fixed hygiene guidelines. Anyone who has worked that way knows discipline is not a side issue here: it is the trade. Precision here lives in the small things. Keeping to the right sequence, spotting a deviation and not letting it through, recording your work so that it adds up. If that is how you work, you will feel at home. Assembling products and components to drawings and work instructions; Carrying out service, inspection and overhaul work; Cleaning, checking and preparing products for further processing; Spotting and recording deviations; Sterile packing and getting products ready for shipment; Contributing ideas to improve the production process.
